title: Fix Windows Copilot launch
body: Repair PR #39 so npm-installed copilot.cmd shims launch correctly on Windows and all CLI-subprocess test helpers decode UTF-8 consistently.

log.text: Investigating reviewed Windows launch and UTF-8 test-helper blockers
Implemented explicit cmd.exe shim invocation with hardened quoting and completed UTF-8 decoding across CLI/skills subprocess helpers
Focused platform, CLI, and skills tests passed: 263 tests, 3 skipped
Full unittest suite passed: 535 tests, 3 skipped; diff check clean
PR #39 merge blockers fixed; focused 263-test run and full 535-test suite passed, with UTF-8 helper coverage and Windows shim regression added
